recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Future generated StructureDefinition outputs should pick up prd-1/prd-2 from the spreadsheet source; FHIR-46350 was only a background issue in the earlier mixed commit and should remain separate.
issue_request: FHIR-46626 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested that ParameterDefinition.min/max match ElementDefinition.min/max safeguards: non-negative min, min <= max, and max as a number or '*'.
initial_application: Commit 8e42147627f507755f642e3284bf832f1082b194 was already present in source history and mentioned FHIR-46626, but it applied equivalent checks to OperationDefinition.parameter and StructureMap.group.rule.source rather than to ParameterDefinition. The current ParameterDefinition source still used integer for min and had no min/max invariants.
additional_context: The reporter's Zulip thread framed the missing rules as an oversight, and FHIR-I minutes recorded an 8-0-0 Persuasive vote. source/fhir.ini confirms ParameterDefinition is active under metadatatypes and normative, and publish.ini copies the FHIR ModelInfo file that exposes ParameterDefinition to publication output.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/parameterdefinition.xml so ParameterDefinition.min is unsignedInt, min and max reference the new Min <= Max invariant, max says 'a number or *', and the Invariants sheet defines Min <= Max plus Max SHALL be a number or '*'. Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so ParameterDefinition.min is FHIR.unsignedInt in ModelInfo.
source_changes: source/datatypes/parameterdefinition.xml: ParameterDefinition.min is now unsignedInt, ParameterDefinition.min/max reference invariant 1, ParameterDefinition.max wording now says 'a number or *', and the Invariants sheet defines min <= max plus max-number-or-* constraints.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: ParameterDefinition.min ModelInfo type is now FHIR.unsignedInt.
